description: fx2-cmix fork with deterministic MediaWiki structural sidecar contexts for schema fields, page kind, page/column buckets, word tails, entities, refs, links, templates, and slots
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
notes: Built from external/fx2-cmix with GCC using SEED=923 and UPDATE_LIMIT=3000. cmix.bin.gz and english.dic.gz are counted by the harness.
verdict: Promote to 100MB gate. The 10MB scored result beats fx2cmix_wrapped_v1 by 402336 bytes: archive is 649 bytes smaller and counted program is 401687 bytes smaller.
